name: Leslie
headline: Turn Sunweb’s booking data into trips that get rebooked.
saw: Your homepage most likely greets a first-time visitor and a returning guest with the same trips and offers, as is common across travel arrangement sites. Every visitor sees it the same way.

Where a traveller goes, when they book, which options they pick and which trips they skip is the strongest signal you have for the next holiday and the next lapse. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti-churn campaigns are usually built by hand, per segment, per month. A traveller who is about to drop off after their last trip this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: Lapse signals per customer from booking history and contact patterns. The right offer, channel and moment for each traveller, tested continuously, not one reminder for the whole list.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next trip when it fits
cases.text: Next best trip and add-on per customer, picked from what they booked and when. No more blanket upsell mails to people who already bought the right package.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every traveller planning the next trip
cases.text: Personal destination nudges across email and your existing channels, so each customer has a reason to plan again between holidays, not only when a campaign goes out.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
